skill.name: set-up-cloudflare-chatgpt-ads-ltv-bidding
skill.description: Use Product Metrics to set up customer lifetime value bidding in ChatGPT Ads for a Cloudflare-tracked storefront. Verify revenue or profit events from paid orders before selecting the campaign conversion yourself.
skill.summary: Set up and verify lifetime value conversions for a Cloudflare storefront in ChatGPT Ads.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: The reconnaissance alerts and most Markdown backtick alerts are false positives. Retained findings involve external setup writes, order access, installation, and reliance on remote tools or instructions. The review identified credential, permission, privacy, and campaign configuration risks, but found no evidence of malware or an attempt to manipulate the audit.

remediation.issue: API credentials can enter assistant or CLI logs.
remediation.suggestion: Require users to enter the key directly in the verified Product Metrics app. Remove the assistant exception for requesting credentials or passing them to commands.

remediation.issue: Setup writes lack an explicit approval step.
remediation.suggestion: Present the exact workspace, property, requested change, and effect before each mutation. Require approval and restrict the MCP setup operations to those needed.

remediation.issue: Browser handoffs and remote references expand trust beyond the reviewed bundle.
remediation.suggestion: Verify scheme and expected origin before handing off a browser URL. Use bundled references or a pinned, reviewed revision instead of live Markdown instructions.

remediation.issue: Cloudflare approval does not explain or limit the requested permissions.
remediation.suggestion: List the required permissions and their purposes. Ask the administrator to verify the intended zone and reject unexpected access requests.

remediation.issue: Destination setup can enable broader tracking than the LTV task requires.
remediation.suggestion: Show all event types and fields before enabling delivery. Verify that a consent-denied test sends nothing and reduce optional data sharing where supported.

remediation.issue: A test-order check can surface unrelated customer records.
remediation.suggestion: Require an exact synthetic test order identifier. Report delivery status and event type without returning customer identifiers or unrelated order details.

remediation.issue: The main skill names the wrong conversion for profit LTV.
remediation.suggestion: Replace pm_order_profit with pm_profit_ltv in the LTV handoff. Verify the selected event against the user's objective before the campaign goes live.

remediation.issue: The optional installer uses an unpinned package and skill source.
remediation.suggestion: Document a reviewed installer version and an immutable skill revision. Keep installation separate from routine setup and require explicit user authorization.

semantic_findings.title: Credential instructions conflict with secure entry
semantic_findings.description: The main skill permits asking for an OpenAI Conversions API key and passing it to a command. The reference says never to paste it into chat. The exception can expose the key in transcripts, tool records, or command arguments.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The written instructions explicitly conflict. No evidence shows that a key was collected or leaked.

semantic_findings.title: Cloudflare approval is broader than explained
semantic_findings.description: The troubleshooting guide tells the administrator to approve every permission without listing required scopes. The integration adds tracking across the selected domain, so the administrator should verify the requested access before approving it.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The blanket approval instruction and sitewide tracking are explicit. The actual permission scopes are not shown.

semantic_findings.title: Destination setup can enable broader event sharing
semantic_findings.description: Linking the destination leaves sending enabled for more than lifetime value. With consent, events can include transaction identifiers, hashed customer identifiers, and IP addresses. The setup does not prompt the user to review those fields before activation.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The enabled setting and payload fields are documented. The guide describes consent checks, and no bypass is shown.

semantic_findings.title: Test-order verification can expose another order
semantic_findings.description: The test prompt provides no order identifier, but the assistant is told to list orders newest first and retrieve details. A recent live order could be mistaken for the test and expose customer or margin information.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The prompt and lookup do not require an exact test identifier. A mistaken match is possible, not observed.

semantic_findings.title: Conflicting instructions can select the wrong conversion
semantic_findings.description: The main skill recommends pm_order_profit for profit bidding inside the LTV workflow. The LTV guide instead specifies pm_profit_ltv. Following the main instruction can direct campaign spend toward per-order profit rather than lifetime profit.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The references explicitly distinguish the two events. The conflicting instruction appears in the campaign handoff.

semantic_findings.title: Browser handoff lacks an origin check
semantic_findings.description: The skill tells the assistant to relay a browser URL returned by a setup tool without verifying its origin. A compromised response could direct the user to a deceptive sign-in or authorization page.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The handoff accepts a response URL and specifies no origin check. No evidence shows that a malicious URL was returned.

content.user_title: Set Up ChatGPT Ads LTV Bidding on Cloudflare
content.value_statement: A first order does not show how much a customer may spend over time. Use Product Metrics to verify lifetime value events before selecting a ChatGPT Ads campaign conversion.
actual_capabilities: Checks Product Metrics setup status through its CLI or MCP and identifies unfinished steps.
Guides a workspace administrator through Cloudflare Tracking and storefront setup without a store plugin.
Guides the user through connecting a ChatGPT Ads pixel and checking server-side event delivery.
Explains revenue and profit lifetime value events and the costs required for profit reporting.
Checks test-order records and explains how the campaign owner selects a conversion.
limitations: Requires Product Metrics Pro, a proxied Cloudflare storefront, and access to the relevant accounts.
Lifetime value is based on observed paid orders from recognized customers, not forecasts or imported order history.
Profit lifetime value depends on configured costs, including an estimated product cost for Cloudflare orders.
The user authorizes Cloudflare access and selects the campaign conversion in Ads Manager.

use_cases.title: Check storefront readiness
use_cases.description: Find missing tracking, consent, and account prerequisites before connecting an advertising destination.

use_cases.title: Plan a lifetime value campaign
use_cases.description: Compare revenue and profit lifetime value events before choosing which conversion to use for one campaign.

use_cases.title: Validate delivery after setup
use_cases.description: Check whether an authorized synthetic order reached Product Metrics and whether the intended event reached the ads pixel.

prompt_templates.title: Explain the prerequisites
prompt_templates.prompt: What do I need to set up revenue lifetime value bidding for my Cloudflare storefront? Explain which steps I must do myself.

prompt_templates.title: Review the current setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the Product Metrics setup for my selected storefront. List missing prerequisites without changing settings or asking for keys.

prompt_templates.title: Verify one test order
prompt_templates.prompt: Check synthetic order TEST-104 in the approved property. Report whether its revenue lifetime value event arrived without showing customer data or other orders.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a profit LTV rollout
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare revenue and profit lifetime value for one campaign. Verify cost coverage, consent settings, and the conversion name against the LTV guide. Propose a rollout without making changes.

output_examples.input: Can I use profit lifetime value before adding product costs?
output_examples.output: Start with revenue lifetime value if costs are missing. Profit lifetime value requires complete costs, including a product cost estimate for Cloudflare orders.

output_examples.input: The connection test passed. Is my campaign ready to switch?
output: The connection test validates the destination. It does not prove that a paid order reached Ads Manager.
Verify delivery with an authorized test order and confirm that the intended lifetime value conversion appears.
Select the conversion yourself after checking it against your bidding objective.

best_practices: Confirm the workspace, storefront zone, and ads pixel before approving changes. Enter API credentials only in the verified app.
Check the actual consent banner and use a synthetic order with a known identifier to verify delivery.
Confirm the lifetime value conversion in Ads Manager and start with one campaign.
anti_patterns: Pasting a Conversions API key into an assistant chat or tool call.
Selecting the per-order profit event when the campaign should optimize for profit lifetime value.
Assuming the newest order is the test order or sharing customer details to prove delivery.

faq.question: Do I need a store plugin?
faq.answer: No. This workflow uses Cloudflare Tracking on a proxied storefront and reads purchases reported by the order confirmation page.

faq.question: What value does each event carry?
faq.answer: Each event carries what a recognized customer's paid order adds to lifetime revenue or profit. It does not send a predicted lifetime total.

faq.question: Can I use profit LTV without exact product costs?
faq.answer: Cloudflare orders use a product cost estimate and configured additional costs. The profit event requires complete cost inputs.

faq.question: Which consent does an LTV event need?
faq.answer: The guide requires both marketing and analytics consent. Without ad personalization consent, eligible events are marked as opted out.

faq.question: Will my past orders or later refunds update Ads Manager?
faq.answer: This Cloudflare workflow does not import historical orders. Later refunds do not revise conversion events already sent to ChatGPT Ads.

faq.question: Who selects the conversion that controls bidding?
faq.answer: The campaign owner selects it in ChatGPT Ads Manager. The assistant can help verify event delivery and identify the appropriate conversion.
